title: R' Tanchum son of R' Yose
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Vayetze 22; Hyman says it seems that the reading should be “R' Tanchum in the name of R' Assi.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Buber Tanchuma digital text, Vayetze 22, includes the bracketed wording אמר ר׳ תנחום ר׳ יוסי. Hyman’s heading gives Tanchum son of Yose; “in the name of Rabbi Assi” is his tentative proposed reading.

The actual Buber Tanchuma Vayetze 22 paragraph has the bracketed abbreviated wording אמר ר' תנחום ר' יוסי. It does not independently supply the proposed in-the-name-of R' Assi reading or full titles for the supplied alternatives. The body retains Hyman’s tentative “it seems that it should read,” all abbreviated titles remain R', and son-of versus in-the-name-of is not adopted as an identity or teacher relationship.
